label: def:cemetery-group
title: Cemetery group (subcategory annihilated by $\tau$)
html:
Definition. Let H_n(R, q) be the Iwahori–Hecke algebra and let \mathcal{K}_n denote the category of finitely generated graded projective modules over the Khovanov–Lauda–Rouquier algebra whose cyclotomic quotient is H_n(R, q). The fibre functor \tau \colon \mathcal{K}_n \to \mathrm{Vect} acts as decategorification by graded Euler characteristic. For a graded module M = \bigoplus_{d \in \mathbb{Z}} M_d,

  \tau(M) \;:=\; \sum_{d \in \mathbb{Z}} (-1)^d \dim_R M_d \;\in\; R.

The cemetery group of H_n(R, q) is the localising Serre subcategory

  \mathcal{Z}_n \;:=\; \ker \tau
  \;=\; \{\, M \in \mathcal{K}_n : \tau(M) = 0 \,\}.

Its objects are the homologically acyclic complexes. Physically, these are the decoupled or non-observable interaction channels.

Remark. The cemetery group is emergent. It is defined as the kernel of \tau rather than postulated. We use \mathcal{Z}_n computationally as a homological filter on crystal-graph traversals.
